coherence.rule: Every index uses one common market anchor and one common horizon start. Low-frequency series use the last real observation at or before each anchor. Canonical series whose history spans zero are consistently excluded from ratio rebasing across every horizon, because percentage ratios across zero are mathematically unstable. Concentration is reported as a diagnostic, not treated as automatic failure, because unchanged low-frequency components can legitimately concentrate short-horizon movement in market-rate components. All omissions are explicit; no substitute series or hidden transformation is used.
